每 6 小时检查已登记来源。抓取成功仅表示页面可读，事实与条款仍由编辑复核。: Registered sources are checked every 6 hours. A successful fetch means the page was readable; editors still review facts and conditions.
后台批次运行中，可稍后回来查看。: A background batch is running. You can return later.
首次抓取建立基线，不自动更新内容核查日期。: The first fetch creates a baseline and does not update editorial verification dates.
无法读取来源监测，请稍后重试。: Could not load source monitoring. Please try again.
检查未启动，可能已有批次在运行。请刷新查看。: The check did not start; a batch may already be running. Refresh to check.
复核未保存，内容可能已变化。请刷新后再次查看。: The review was not saved; the content may have changed. Refresh and review it again.
目前没有待处理的来源变化。尚未抓取的来源可在全部来源中查看。: No source changes currently need attention. Unchecked sources are listed under All sources.
页面可能阻止自动访问、需要 JavaScript 或暂时不可用，请手动查看。此状: The page may block automated access, require JavaScript, or be temporarily unavailable. Check it manually; this does not mean the event is cancelled.
记录官网确认结果，以及需要修改的站内内容。: Record what the official page confirms and any site content that needs updating.
确认复核只记录处理结果，不会自动修改站内活动、优惠或原核查日期。: Acknowledging records the review result. It does not automatically edit events, offers, or original verification dates.
官方页面有变化，待编辑复核；出发前请查看官方信息。: The official page has changed and is awaiting editorial review. Check the official details before going.
最新自动检查未完成，请查看官方信息。: The latest automated check could not be completed. Check the official details.
仅保存按日汇总的匿名计数，不识别用户。同一人可产生多次操作；这些数值不是用户人数: Only anonymous daily counts are stored, without identifying users. One person may perform an action several times; these numbers are not user counts, conversion rates or return rates.
暂时无法读取使用统计，未将缺失数据记为零。: Usage statistics are unavailable. Missing data has not been counted as zero.
